classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round is bracketed by barrier.wait() before and after the _read_staged of manifest(workdir, r, ...), so every rank is held at the synchronisation point until that one round's manifest read completes, and each round uses its own file m%d, giving one read per rank per file.

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: After the post-manifest barrier each rank does its own _read(sidecar(workdir, me, i, ...)) on its private r%d files with no barrier in between, and the loop over sidecars sits inside the 200-round loop so each sidecar file is read once per round.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: Each rank synchronously _read()s its own shard(workdir, me, i) files with no intervening barrier, and the shard loop runs inside the cell.rounds=200 loop, so each shard file is read once per round by its owning rank only.
